title: Build a Developer Portfolio That Impresses Recruiters in 10 Seconds
description: Recruiters spend an average of 10 seconds glancing at your portfolio before deciding to interview you. This ultra-clean, fast-loading template highlights your top 3 live projects, GitHub metrics, and tech stack.

promptSet.title: Recruiter-Optimized Project Case Study Writer
promptSet.prompt: Write a concise, high-impact case study summary for my full-stack web project. Highlight: Problem Statement, Tech Stack Chosen (and why), Engineering Challenges Overcome, and Measurable Outcome (e.g. latency reduced, users served).
instructions: Clone the minimal portfolio repository from GitHub.
Edit the single projects.json data file with your projects.
Deploy to Vercel or GitHub Pages in under 2 minutes.
promptSet.exampleOutput: Punchy 3-bullet project case study with metrics that catch engineering managers' attention.
